scope: Secondary predictive uncertainty and descriptive development OOF error analysis; functions implemented, real forecast evaluation pending

predictive_intervals.primary_fit_reference: The primary development fit may use training outcomes through 2024-12-24; it is not calibrated with its own November-December training residuals

branch_selection.source: Complete eligible candidate cohort, nested temporal development OOF, truncated through 2024-10-24 for this branch only
branch_selection.metric: Mean original-scale RMSE across paired seed trajectories on the same eligible origins
branch_selection.status: pending complete nested-development evidence; P0 diagnostic ranking cannot substitute

predictive_intervals.predictor: Fixed arithmetic mean of at least five predeclared frozen branch-A seed members; deterministic references stored once with zero randomized-fit count
predictive_intervals.freeze_rule: All member weights, scalers, selected epochs and configuration close before actual calibration scoring. No refit or early-stop with calibration labels; same run IDs and predictor signature at evaluation
predictive_intervals.actual_execution_timestamps: Recorded in UTC when the retrospective replay runs; nominal 2024 origins are not a claim that forecasts existed live in 2024
predictive_intervals.residual_score: abs(truth minus the same frozen ensemble point forecast)
predictive_intervals.temporal_method: Time-weighted split residual intervals; weights 2^(-(2024-12-30 minus calibration origin in days)/28), fixed test mass1
predictive_intervals.weighted_quantile_rule: Smallest score whose cumulative weight reaches (1-alpha)*(sum calibration weights+1). Insufficient finite mass is not estimated; no zero/infinite fabricated interval
predictive_intervals.dependence_and_shift_limit: Overlapping sigma7 labels, finite calibration history, model-selection uncertainty and the long 2024-to-2026 gap defeat an automatic exchangeability claim. Recency weights are an explicit heuristic, not estimated density-ratio weights or a proved coverage bound
predictive_intervals.evaluation_status: known historical secondary evaluation; no new unknown test assigned; no current scoring
report: Nominal versus empirical coverage by level/horizon
Pinball loss of reported lower/upper quantiles
WIS with the central forecast submitted as quantile0.5
Conditional coverage by causal subgroup and train-frozen forecast range
Point performance of branch A and primary comparable predictor side by side on identical dates
predictive_intervals.CRPS: Only from an explicitly declared empirical predictive CDF, for example signed calibration residuals shifted by the frozen point forecast and clipped at zero, with stated weights. Optimization-seed dispersion alone is not a predictive distribution

bootstrap.unit: complete daily origin calendar; preserve masks, horizons and paired trajectories
bootstrap.intervals: nominal descriptive95%, not simultaneous or exact under long dependence

error_analysis.source_boundary: E1 metrics, ETTh1 and November-December pilot predictions cannot be relabelled as new January-October OOF. P0 fixed-recipe OOF is diagnostic, not a completed final benchmark or proof of final Top3
error_analysis.case_unit: one daily origin per model; initialization seeds remain paired trajectories, not extra cases
error_analysis.calendar_mask: Require every model/seed/date cell; keep ineligible dates as blank placeholders on the full calendar and use the same eligibility and ground truth across models
error_analysis.information_guard: Each inherited monthly OOF fold freezes fit/scaler/configuration outcomes by first validation origin of the month minus8 days. Keep the same run/checkpoint and support throughout that month; t-minus8 daily refitting is not silently substituted
error_analysis.taxonomy_thresholds: q50 and q90 of absolute errors of an identified fixed training reference (for example lag1 persistence); at least20 distinct training outcomes, ending at most2023-12-24; never fit to analyzed2024 errors or test
error_analysis.taxonomy_rule: Magnitude is mean absolute error across seed members, so cancellation does not hide instability. Low: <=q50. Moderate: >q50 and <=q90. Large: >q90. Above low, under/over requires every seed error to share its strict sign; otherwise mixed. Categories are MECE including ties and zero

stratified_audit_sample.allocation: one per nonempty stratum then proportional largest-remainder allocation
stratified_audit_sample.frequencies: computed on all eligible OOF origins, not unweighted frequencies of the stratified sample

outputs: Category counts/frequencies with temporal block intervals
Private unique-origin stratified audit ledger and inclusion weights
Shared large-error frequency and pairwise Jaccard overlap
Descriptive equal-weight ensemble complementarity, with observed-best-reference optimism declared
